What's Included in the Ölüdeniz Paragliding Price?

Unlike many adventure activities, the Ölüdeniz paragliding price is genuinely all-inclusive. Here's exactly what your money pays for:

  • Babadağ Mountain Access Fee — $45: A government-mandated charge for cable car + forestry road. Included free with SkyHigh.
  • $1M Aviation Insurance — $20: Full third-party liability + personal accident. See our safety standards.
  • THK T2 Licensed Pilot: Your pilot has 1,500+ flight hours and extensive safety training.
  • Free Hotel Transfer: Air-conditioned minibus from Fethiye, Hisarönü, Ovacık, or Ölüdeniz.
  • EN 926 Certified Equipment: Ozone/Gin tandem wings, reserve parachute, life vest.

Why Are Some Ölüdeniz Prices Cheaper?

If someone offers paragliding in Ölüdeniz for $80-100, corners are being cut:

  • 🚩 Forestry fee NOT included — you pay $45 extra at the gate
  • 🚩 Lower takeoff (1,200m instead of 1,960m — shorter flight)
  • 🚩 No insurance or minimal coverage ($5K vs. our $1M)
  • 🚩 Unlicensed freelance pilot without THK T2 certification
